message.content:
{"diagnosis": "o_rd/result_bool with bo=01 and rs1==op_b returns 1 while the trace expects 0 for both rs1=op_b=0 and rs1=op_b=1. Unequal-operand bo=01 cases already read 0 and all bo=00/10/11 cases pass. Root cause is BOOL_LUT=16'h8E96 whose bo=01 nibble is 0x9 (equality/XNOR) so equal inputs index a 1 instead of required 0.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/rtl/serv_alu.v b/rtl/serv_alu.v
--- a/rtl/serv_alu.v
+++ b/rtl/serv_alu.v
@@ -42,1 +42,1 @@
-    localparam [15:0] BOOL_LUT = 16'h8E96;//And, Or, =, xor
+    localparam [15:0] BOOL_LUT = 16'h8E06;//And, Or, =, xor", "expected": "tohost: PASS, no TRAP bool lut mismatch, all bo checks ok"}
